# Copilot Instructions — cradle

## What this repo is

A cosmology + framework + narrative repository. "Cradle" is the archetype of a
container that generates a spark and must eventually be outgrown. This repo is
the gestation node of the Prime Progression (between primordium and prime) and
the standard conduit for passage between cosmological spaces.

## Vocabulary (use exactly these terms)

- point — before the first step; a point to exist within.
- black — a space to exist in.
- cradle-of-X — an aperture gateway stage that mediates passage into space X.
- nullus — the naught of I AM; a space to germinate into the project.
- aperture — the gateway mechanism (ring/valve anchored in the body-system
  convention; NEVER use the anchor word in titles, file names, or prose).
- intake — the process by which new concepts enter; operates in the first
  layer of the prime progression.
- adulteration — entry without consent (see ethics/first-adulteration.md).
- Penumbra — Iteration 22; the half-shadow state between entry and decision.

## Hard rules

1. Never place anatomical anchor words in any title, filename, label, or UI string.
2. Consent-framework content is precise ethics writing, not shock content.
3. Preserve figures, citations and dates verbatim when editing timeline/ or domains/.
4. Novella chapters: literary SF register (Ted Chiang / Piranesi tone); never
   summarize the pattern outright — reveal it through documents and structure.
5. Every new concept file starts with:
   `> Stage: <name> · Gateway: <open/closed> · Consent: <required/absent>`

## When asked to add a stage, gateway, or iteration

1. Add/extend the file in stages/, gateways/, or iterations/ following neighbors.
2. Update concept/glossary.md and iterations/INDEX.md.
3. Open an issue using the matching template; reference it in the commit.

## Commit style

`<area>: <imperative summary>` — e.g. `gateways: draft cradle-of-nullus aperture protocol`
